name: Weighted Blended Order-Independent Transparency
definition: A weight-based sorting OIT technique that reduces computational cost by performing sorting in a single pass without depth-based sorting, using weights in the translucency equation to estimate occlusion.
summary: Weighted Blended Order-Independent Transparency is a single-pass rendering technique that approximates depth-sorted blending by modifying fragment weights, avoiding explicit sorting for efficient performance on resource-constrained hardware.
